### `> about.txt`

```text
I study how datacenter networks spread traffic across paths. My MSc thesis implemented
CONGA in ns-3 and explored Power of Two Choices; that variant did not improve on CONGA.

I’m now evaluating smoothed RTT as a congestion signal for flowlet routing. Results are
preliminary. Outside research, I build embedded projects and run a home lab.
```
